newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-MENOTTI 90% SURE OF MOVE TO SAMPDORIA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MENOTTI 90% SURE OF MOVE TO SAMPDORIA.

text.p: Argentine coach Cesar Menotti says that he is "90 percent" certain of moving to serie A side Sampdoria next season.

"It looks like I'll be coaching Sampdoria next year. It looks 90 percent sure," he told Italian sports newspaper Gazzetta dello Sport in an interview from Argentina, where he coaches club side Independiente.
Menotti, 59, said Sampdoria club director Emiliano Salvarezza and Filippo Mantovani, brother of club President Enrico, came to Argentina this week to discuss terms.
"We have more or less settled the conditions for my transfer to Sampdoria but I will be able to finally wrap it up only in two or three weeks time when I decide how what to do about Independiente.
"In my contract, there is a clause allowing for a joint decision (on the future) to be taken before the end of April."
Menotti was Argentine national coach from 1974 to 1982, becoming an international celebrity as the chain smoking, cerebral figure on the bench during Argentina's 1978 World Cup win.
At club level, he has coached Newell's Old Boys, Boca Juniors and River Plate in his own country as well as Barcelona and Atletico Madrid in Spain and Penarol in Uruguay.
Sampdoria are currently coached by Swede Sven-Goran Eriksson, who will move to serie A side Lazio next season.
